method.formula: oxygen (cc) = (container volume − product weight in g as cc) × 0.21
method.note: Sorbent Systems method: product volume = its weight in grams (1 g = 1 cc), so the air between grains (voidspace) is counted with the headspace. Round up to the next absorber size.
method.source: Sorbent Systems: oxygen absorbers, measuring volume of oxygen
